# News Pebbles · Search & Grade Guides

> Curated current-events reading guides and searchable story texts for kids, parents, and educators.

## Guides by Grade & Topic
- [Free kids newspaper to print](https://newspebbles.com/find/kids-newspaper.html): Calm daily printable newspaper for kids with checkable sources.
- [Free kids newsletter & daily current events](https://newspebbles.com/find/kids-newsletter.html): Daily current events newsletter for children and families.
- [Current events for 5th grade, printable](https://newspebbles.com/find/grades/5th-grade.html): Short printable paper for ages 9 to 11 with checkable sources.
- [Current events for 6th grade](https://newspebbles.com/find/grades/6th-grade.html): Daily one-page overview for middle schoolers.
- [Homeschool current events for middle school](https://newspebbles.com/find/homeschool.html): Weekly paper with discussion questions.
- [Printable current events for kids](https://newspebbles.com/find/printable.html): US Letter printables, no login required.
- [News for kids without scary content](https://newspebbles.com/find/calm.html): Calm news for ages 6 to 8 without graphic detail.
- [A printable alternative to classroom kids news](https://newspebbles.com/find/compare.html): Factual comparisons with listed sources.
- [Current affairs for kids in India](https://newspebbles.com/find/india.html): Daily digest for ages 15+ and Indian competitive exams.
- [All stories archive](https://newspebbles.com/find/archive.html): Complete searchable archive of published lead stories.
